common_checks: Exactly one h1 and the hero image is first on the page
Copy avoids the user's avoid-list tone
Final action navigates the preview to the generated page

evals.name: new-prompt-happy-path
evals.prompt: Create a landing page for a dog-walking app. Friendly tone, avoid anything corporate.
expected: Asks for a starting point first, with Figma file listed first
Collects missing intake fields without re-asking what the prompt already answered
Generates three options (-a, -b, -c) and shares their URLs
Waits for the user to choose before building the full page
Asks for confirmation before deleting the unchosen options
Final page exists at /landing/<slug> and the preview is navigated to it

evals.name: update-existing-page
evals.prompt: Change the headline on /landing/sample-launch to something punchier.
expected: Reads the existing JSON instead of starting from scratch
Shows a before/after table of changed fields before writing
Does not regenerate the hero image

evals.name: collision-and-placeholder
evals.prompt: Create a landing page called sample-launch about a new smart thermostat. (Simulate the image API returning placeholder: true.)
expected: Detects the existing sample-launch.json and asks before overwriting or picks a new slug
Reports the image error to the user and offers a retry
Does not silently overwrite any file

evals.name: html-source-start
evals.prompt:
Turn this HTML into a landing page:

Learn guitar in 30 days

Short lessons, real songs.

Start free
expected: Chooses the HTML source starting point without asking the intake questions the HTML already answers
Extracts headline, subhead and CTA from the HTML
Still writes sections and a hero image prompt, with the hero on the first fold
